value.rationale: The two coefficients are standard competing network-level summaries and differ only by how local clustering is aggregated. A sharp first ranking reversal therefore isolates a practically relevant aggregation effect. The matched witness has the same number of vertices, edges, and triangles on both sides, showing that leaf placement and induced wedge weighting alone can flip the conclusion.
